llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究感染性全髋关节置换术的临床管理，不涉及任何生物力学建模或假体设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study on infected hip arthroplasty revisions, with no biomechanical analysis, stress shielding, micromotion, or finite element modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析感染全髋关节置换术后再次清创、长期间隔物保留和死亡率的风险因素。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性研究患者数据，使用多变量回归分析风险因素。
summary_zh.result: 确定了与不良结果相关的独立风险因素，如年龄和合并症。
summary_zh.validation: 临床数据验证，基于患者记录。

summary_en.motivation: To identify risk factors for repeat debridement, long-term spacer retention, and mortality after infected total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of patient data with multivariate regression to determine independent risk factors.
summary_en.result: Independent risk factors such as age and comorbidities were significantly associated with adverse outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Validation through clinical data review without biomechanical or computational modeling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光选区熔化制备功能梯度硅基复合材料，完全不涉及生物医学植入物或骨力学匹配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on in-situ synthesis of functionally graded silicon matrix composites via SLM, with no porous bone-mimicking structures, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no biomedical context, and no osseointegration or fatigue testing relevant to orthopedic implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用SLM原位制备功能梯度硅基复合材料以改善性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM工艺参数调控，实现硅基复合材料的成分梯度化。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了具有梯度结构的硅基复合材料，并表征了其微观组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观分析和力学测试验证了梯度结构的形成与性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a method for in-situ fabrication of functionally graded silicon matrix composites using selective laser melting to achieve tailored properties.
summary_en.method: The SLM process parameters are controlled to create a compositional gradient within the silicon matrix composite during printing.
summary_en.result: Functionally graded composites with gradient microstructure and improved mechanical properties were successfully produced.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing of the graded regions.

papers.title: Influence of Powder Bed Characteristics on Material Quality in Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract: In powder bed based Additive Manufacturing (AM) processes like Selective Laser Melting (SLM) or Electron Beam Melting (EBM), the spatial distribution of the individual powder particles is typically unknown. Nevertheless, the distribution of particles in the heat affected zone defines the thermophysical properties of the region being processed by the heat source and therefore plays a crucial role in heat transfer processes. In this work, the spatial distribution of individual particles and their influence on the AM process is numerically investigated. Two powder bed configurations are compared: One powder bed is generated using the discrete element method (DEM) to model the coating process; the second powder bed is arranged in the BCC structure. The melting and solidification of both configurations are modelled. The predicted melt pool dimensions are compared with experimentally determined values. The results indicate that modelling the coating process is necessary to ensure accurate modelling of the heat source powder bed interaction as well as an accurate prediction of the melt pool characteristics.

papers.title: Intraoperative dislocation of the trial bipolar cup into the pelvis during bipolar hip arthroplasty - A case report
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Bipolar hip arthroplasty is a good option for treating femoral neck fractures, although some contraindications have been indicated. We report a case of intraoperative dislocation of the trial bipolar cup into the pelvis during bipolar hip arthroplasty. CASE PRESENTATION: A 74-year-old woman underwent bipolar hip arthroplasty for a femoral neck fracture (AO31-B2). She was placed in a lateral decubitus position, and a direct lateral approach was used. During intraoperative trial reduction, the trial bipolar cup became disengaged and dislocated into the anterior space of hip joint. Several attempts to retrieve it failed. The permanent femoral component was inserted, and the wound was closed. The patient was repositioned supine to allow an ilioinguinal approach, and the component was easily removed. She had an uneventful, good recovery. DISCUSSION: Several cases of intraoperative dislocation of the femoral trial head during total hip arthroplasty have been reported, this is the first report of dislocation of a bipolar trial cup. A previous report described difficulty retrieving a trial cup. CONCLUSION: We easily removed our trial cup using another approach. It is vital to plan systematically for this frustrating complication.

llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case report about surgical complication; it does not involve any biomechanical modeling, stress analysis, or implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 报告双极人工髋关节置换术中试模杯脱位的罕见并发症。
summary_zh.method: 通过病例回顾，描述了一例74岁女性患者的术中脱位及处理过程。
summary_zh.result: 采用髂腹股沟入路成功取出脱位的试模杯，患者恢复良好。
summary_zh.validation: 无验证，为单一病例报告。

summary_en.motivation: To report an intraoperative dislocation of a trial bipolar cup during bipolar hip arthroplasty, a rare complication.
summary_en.method: A single case report of a 74-year-old female patient with femoral neck fracture undergoing bipolar hip arthroplasty, where the trial cup dislodged and was retrieved via ilioinguinal approach.
summary_en.result: The trial cup was successfully removed through a separate approach, and the patient recovered uneventfully.
summary_en.validation: This is a single case report with no systematic validation.
